locators.locator: FY2013 annual report PDF pp. 9-10: channel reorganization already reported for FY2013; sales volume, realized price, revenue, expense and operating-cash baseline.
FY2013 annual report PDF pp. 14-15: payment-before-shipment discipline, receivables, inventory, construction in progress, borrowings, network coverage and installed/in-build capacity.
FY2013 annual report PDF p. 19: FY2014 volume/revenue/cost budget; market, channel, logistics, cost, procurement and project plans; RMB 3.5bn financing need.

permanent_loss_constraints.condition: Volume growth does not establish value creation if price, unit economics, working capital, cash or capital burden deteriorate.
permanent_loss_constraints.required_treatment: Settle each layer separately and keep causal attribution and permanent-loss implications unknown unless directly supported.

decision_flip_questions.statement: Did the planned channel, terminal-partner and logistics expansion produce observable customer uptake and sales-volume progress?
decision_flip_questions.decision_effect: If not, the expansion mechanism is contradicted at its first operating link.

decision_flip_questions.statement: Did any volume response survive realized-price, cost and selling-expense pressure?
decision_flip_questions.decision_effect: If not, scale cannot be treated as improved operating economics.

decision_flip_questions.statement: Did working-capital discipline and operating cash absorb the expansion and project burden without worsening financing dependence?
decision_flip_questions.decision_effect: If not, the plan may increase capital and permanent-loss exposure despite higher reported volume.

responsibility_units.decision_scope: issuer-level management plan and consolidated operating execution
responsibility_units.economic_carrier: cement and clinker sold into Fujian delivered markets
responsibility_units.measurement_surface: official audited annual-report operating and financial disclosures

arenas.product_or_service_scope: cement and commodity clinker manufactured and sold in Fujian
arenas.customer_task: secure locally delivered cement supply for construction and distribution demand
arenas.competition_mechanism: regional supply-demand, delivered price, channel reach, logistics availability and unit-cost competition
arenas.window: FY2013 cutoff state and FY2014 management plan

operating_variables.name: reported provincial channel and distribution reach
reported cement and clinker sales volume
reported price, cost, expense and cement-segment margin state
reported payment-before-shipment, receivables and inventory state
audited consolidated net cash from operating activities
construction-in-progress, planned capital spending and financing burden
permanent-loss exposure from expansion and financing dependence

mechanisms.description: The FY2014 plan proposes deeper market integration, terminal partnerships and logistics support as a route from provincial distribution reach to customer uptake and sales volume; execution is not yet established.
Sales volume transmits to operating economics only after realized price, production cost and selling expense are measured separately.
Unit economics and payment discipline may transmit operating growth to cash, while aggregate cash changes do not by themselves identify the plan's effect.
Operating cash relative to project and financing burden may change capital-return and permanent-loss exposure; one annual outcome cannot establish permanence.

financial_transmissions.description: Customer and sales-volume response is only the first operating link and does not establish earnings direction before price and cost are observed.
The plan targets volume and cost progress, but the net earnings direction remains outcome-unknown because price and expense can offset volume.
Operating cash is measurable, but owner-cash conversion remains unknown until capital burden and working-capital movements are separated.
The financing and project burden identifies a loss-risk question, not a directional permanent-loss conclusion.

events.problem_statement: Expand sales and absorb growing capacity in a Fujian market exposed to overcapacity and realized-price pressure.
events.strongest_counterargument: Regional demand and the cement price cycle, rather than channel execution, may explain later volume or earnings; added capacity can also purchase volume at poor returns.
unknowns: whether channel reach changed customer uptake
whether volume retained price and unit economics
whether operating cash covered project and financing burden
whether any one-year result was durable

feedback_loops.selection_rationale: The cutoff source states the channel, terminal-partner and logistics plan and exposes future customer uptake and sales volume as its first observable link.
FY2013 already shows that volume and revenue can diverge when price falls, so price, cost and expense must be settled separately before interpreting scale.
Payment discipline and audited operating cash are observable, while project spending and the stated financing need can offset operating progress and therefore require a separate capital/loss thread.

decision_observation.materiality_scope: Issuer-level FY2014 channel, logistics, cost and project plan against the FY2013 consolidated operating baseline.
decision_observation.rationale: The official FY2013 report states a quantified FY2014 budget and a management plan with explicit channel, terminal-partner, logistics, cost, procurement and project transmission paths. It is recorded only as PLANNED.
decision_observation.next_discriminating_evidence: The next official annual report must separately identify implementation, execution, customer/volume response, price-cost-expense economics, cash and project/financing burden.

question_set.question: Can the FY2014 channel, terminal-partner and logistics plan convert added market reach into economically useful volume without sacrificing price, cash or capital resilience?
Do realized price, unit cost and selling expense support or contradict the economics of any volume response?
Do working capital and operating cash absorb the project and financing burden?
Does the next disclosure identify a durable permanent-loss implication rather than a one-year aggregate movement?

claims.statement: Management disclosed a quantified FY2014 operating budget and a channel/logistics/cost/project plan; the decision status is PLANNED, not implemented or executed.
Deeper channel coverage and logistics support may increase customer uptake and sales volume, but regional demand and price conditions are the strongest rival explanation.
Any volume response must be separated from realized price, cost and selling-expense changes before it can support an operating-economics judgment.
Payment discipline and operating cash must be read separately from project and financing burden; aggregate cash movement cannot be attributed to the channel plan.
One next-period filing cannot establish a durable permanent-loss conclusion; the cell remains unknown unless a direct solvency or irreversible capital impairment condition appears.

hypotheses.statement: The FY2014 channel, terminal-partner and logistics plan is implemented and executed sufficiently to produce observable customer and sales-volume progress.
The plan is not implemented or executed, or later volume is better explained by regional demand and price conditions than by channel progress.
Any volume progress retains enough realized price and cost/expense discipline to improve or preserve operating economics.
Price pressure or cost and selling-expense growth absorbs the benefit of any volume progress.
Working-capital discipline and operating cash absorb the expansion and project burden without a material increase in financing dependence.
Working capital, capex or financing burden consumes operating progress and leaves capital return or permanent-loss exposure unresolved or worse.
The FY2014 channel, terminal-partner and logistics plan is implemented and executed sufficiently to produce observable customer and sales-volume progress.
The plan is not implemented or executed, or later volume is better explained by regional demand and price conditions than by channel progress.

evidence_discriminator.observable: Separate evidence of plan implementation/execution and disclosed customer or sales-volume response at the issuer-consolidated Fujian boundary.
evidence_discriminator.expected_if_h_a: Implementation and execution are visible and customer/volume response is consistent with broader reach without relying on narrative attribution.
evidence_discriminator.expected_if_h_b: Implementation or execution remains unverified, volume fails to respond, or market-cycle evidence is at least as plausible.

hypotheses.statement: Any volume progress retains enough realized price and cost/expense discipline to improve or preserve operating economics.
Price pressure or cost and selling-expense growth absorbs the benefit of any volume progress.

evidence_discriminator.observable: Sales volume, realized price, cost and selling expense measured as separate cells at the same issuer boundary.
evidence_discriminator.expected_if_h_a: Volume is not offset by price and cost/expense deterioration, preserving or improving cement operating margin.
evidence_discriminator.expected_if_h_b: Price or cost/expense pressure offsets volume and compresses cement operating margin.

hypotheses.statement: Working-capital discipline and operating cash absorb the expansion and project burden without a material increase in financing dependence.
Working capital, capex or financing burden consumes operating progress and leaves capital return or permanent-loss exposure unresolved or worse.

evidence_discriminator.observable: Receivables/inventory, audited operating cash, project spending, borrowing and direct impairment or solvency indicators are settled separately.
evidence_discriminator.expected_if_h_a: Working capital remains disciplined and operating cash covers more of the project burden without materially greater financing dependence.
evidence_discriminator.expected_if_h_b: Working capital or capital spending consumes cash, financing dependence rises, or permanent-loss evidence remains unresolved.

cell_measurement_contracts.question: Does the next official filing identify the FY2014 plan as still planned, revised, cancelled or completed?
allowed_evidence: explicit plan-status statement in the next official annual report
cell_measurement_contracts.prohibited_inference: Do not infer implementation from repeated aspirations or achieved aggregate results.

cell_measurement_contracts.question: Which planned channel, terminal-partner, logistics, cost or project actions entered service or received committed resources?
allowed_evidence: explicit completed, launched, opened, signed, commissioned or resource-committed disclosure
cell_measurement_contracts.prohibited_inference: Do not treat a target, intention or budget as implementation.

cell_measurement_contracts.question: Which implemented actions were operated at meaningful scope during FY2014?
allowed_evidence: explicit operating scope, utilization, channel count, partner count, logistics coverage or project operation evidence
cell_measurement_contracts.prohibited_inference: Do not infer execution quality from management narrative or total revenue.

cell_measurement_contracts.question: What direct customer, dealer, channel or demand response is disclosed?
allowed_evidence: customer/channel counts, retention, order, market-share or directly attributed demand evidence
cell_measurement_contracts.prohibited_inference: Sales volume alone is not direct customer response.

cell_measurement_contracts.question: What are FY2014 cement and clinker sales volumes on the disclosed issuer boundary?
allowed_evidence: official annual-report sales-volume table or explicit annual sales-volume statement
cell_measurement_contracts.prohibited_inference: Do not attribute volume direction to the plan without implementation and rival-explanation evidence.

cell_measurement_contracts.question: How did realized price, unit cost, selling expense and cement gross margin move?
allowed_evidence: separate official annual-report price, cost, expense and cement-margin fields
cell_measurement_contracts.prohibited_inference: Revenue or profit alone cannot identify unit economics or action effect.

cell_measurement_contracts.question: How did receivables, inventory and audited net operating cash move?
allowed_evidence: audited consolidated balance sheet and cash-flow statement with management explanation
cell_measurement_contracts.prohibited_inference: Aggregate operating cash cannot be attributed to the plan or treated as owner cash.

cell_measurement_contracts.question: Did operating progress cover capital spending and financing burden sufficiently to support a capital-return conclusion?
allowed_evidence: capex, construction-in-progress, debt, finance cost and compatible operating-profit/cash fields
cell_measurement_contracts.prohibited_inference: One-year growth or aggregate cash is insufficient for causal ROIC attribution.

cell_measurement_contracts.question: Does the filing disclose a direct solvency, impairment, refinancing or irreversible capital-loss condition?
allowed_evidence: direct official impairment, covenant, default, going-concern, refinancing or irreversible project-loss evidence
cell_measurement_contracts.prohibited_inference: A single weak or strong year does not establish permanent loss.

cells.baseline_reference: FY2013 official sales-volume baseline at the same issuer boundary.

evidence_refs.field_ref: FY2013 annual report PDF pp. 10-13 and 19: price, cost, expense and margin baseline plus FY2014 cost plan.

cells.baseline_reference: FY2013 official realized-price, cost, expense and cement-margin baseline.

evidence_refs.field_ref: FY2013 annual report PDF pp. 10, 14 and 19: operating cash, working capital and financing/project burden baseline.

cells.baseline_reference: FY2013 audited operating-cash-to-revenue ratio at the same issuer boundary.

evidence_refs.field_ref: FY2013 annual report PDF pp. 14 and 19: financing and project burden without a durable loss observation.

cells.abstain_reason: The cutoff packet identifies financing and project burden but cannot support a five-year permanent-loss probability without future solvency, impairment and refinancing evidence.

strongest_rival.statement: Regional construction demand, the Fujian cement price cycle and capacity additions can explain sales or earnings changes without management channel execution; higher volume can coexist with weaker unit economics and capital returns.
break_conditions: No explicit implementation or operating-scope evidence for the planned channel, partner or logistics changes.
Sales volume fails to improve or only improves while realized price and cement margin deteriorate.
Selling expense, receivables or inventory grow faster than the relevant operating base.
Operating cash fails to absorb project spending and financing dependence increases.
No direct evidence supports a durable capital-return or permanent-loss conclusion.
